import pandas as pd,numpy as np,statsmodels.formula.api as smf
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
w['y']=w['count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL']/w.n_passages
w['late']=(w.year>=1876).astype(int)
w['ap']=w.groupby('author_key').work_id.transform('count')
print(w.year.isna().sum(), w.y.mean())
def est(d):
    g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).y.mean().unstack()
    g=g.dropna(); return (g[1]-g[0]).mean()
print('est',est(w))
print(w.groupby(['genre','late']).y.agg(['mean','count']).unstack())
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
def boot(d,B=1000):
    gs=[x for _,x in d.groupby(['genre','late'])]
    r=[]
    for _ in range(B):
        r.append(est(pd.concat([x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for x in gs])))
    return np.percentile(r,[2.5,97.5])
print('ci',boot(w))
for c in ['genre','origin','date_confidence']:
    print(pd.crosstab(w[c],w.late,normalize='columns').round(3))
print(w.groupby('late')[['n_editions','ap']].mean())
hd=w[w.date_confidence=='high'];print('high',est(hd),boot(hd,500))
m=smf.ols('y~late+C(genre)+C(origin)+C(date_confidence)+np.log(n_editions)+np.log(ap)',w).fit(cov_type='cluster',cov_kwds={'groups':pd.factorize(w.author_key)[0]})
print(m.params['late'],m.conf_int().loc['late'].values)
for o in ['UK','US','unknown']: print(o,est(w[w.origin==o]))
print(w.groupby('decade').y.mean().round(3))
print(w[(w.y>0)&(w.date_confidence=='high')].sample(6,random_state=1)
